ceviri.20: Whose name is the ad account for a Meta Ads campaign opened in?
ceviri.21: The ad account is opened in the brand's name, under the business's own Meta Business Manager; the agency runs the campaigns with administrator access. That way ownership of the account always stays with the business.
ceviri.22: What happens when a Meta ad account is restricted or disabled?
ceviri.23: A restriction usually comes from a policy breach, a payment problem or a suspicious activity flag. The reason is established, an appeal is started, the item flagged as a breach is corrected, and the interruption to the campaign is kept to a minimum.
ceviri.24: Which ad format suits our business, and how is that decided?
ceviri.25: The format decision is made by looking at the range of products, the capacity to produce creative, and the platform habits of the target audience. The decision is validated with small-scale test campaigns.
ceviri.26: How does Meta's ad review work, and why might an ad not be running?
ceviri.27: Every ad goes through Meta's automated review, and a manual one where necessary, before going live; that process is outside the agency's control. Rejection usually comes from prohibited content, a misleading claim or an inconsistency with the landing page; the item is corrected and the ad resubmitted.
ceviri.28: How is retargeting set up, and which visitors see it?
ceviri.29: Retargeting is built on data from the pixel placed on the website and the Conversions API. People who viewed a page, looked at a product or didn't complete the basket are split into separate groups and shown again with an offer that matches their behaviour.
ceviri.30: Which metrics does the Meta ad report include?
ceviri.31: The report covers the core metrics: reach, impressions, click-through rate, number of conversions and cost per result. Added to those are ROAS, which shows the return on ad spend, and breakdowns by audience.

ceviri.49: Meta Advertising Agency Services: Facebook and Instagram Ad Management
ceviri.50: As a Meta advertising agency, TasarımMania manages your business's Facebook and Instagram accounts end to end; the whole process runs from one place, from audience segmentation to choosing ad formats, from retargeting to performance reporting.
ceviri.51: Let's map the scope and price range
ceviri.64: Campaign work starts with the ad account set up in Meta Business Manager.
ceviri.65: The pixel and Conversions API integration measures visitor behaviour and feeds data into campaign optimization. The audience is built in three layers: custom audiences drawn from existing customer lists, lookalike audiences resembling those, and broad audiences based on interests. The campaign structure is split by funnel stage; awareness, consideration and conversion goals are run in separate campaigns, and each stage's bidding strategy is optimized independently.
ceviri.67: Which ad format suits which goal, and how is retargeting set up?
ceviri.68: The format is chosen according to the nature of the product or service.
ceviri.69: A static image is strong for getting a message across quickly, and the collection format suits showing several products; short video and the Reels placement have high attention-grabbing power but need more production. The decision is made by weighing past campaign data and creative production capacity together. In the retargeting layer, site visitors, video viewers and users who didn't complete the basket are split into separate groups; each group is targeted again with a message matched to its level of interest. Advertising regulations apply on social channels too;

The layers darken inwards. Below, three labels showing the campaign goals: awareness, consideration, conversion. In the animation the account box comes in first, then the connector, then the layers from the outside in.
ceviri.93: Choosing the format: four ad formats given equal weight — illustrative graphic
ceviri.94: Four format cards in a two-by-two grid: a static image shown as a square placeholder, a collection as three small cards side by side with an arrow, short video as a horizontal frame with a play triangle, and Reels as a vertical frame. All four are drawn with the same border and the same fill; none is selected or given prominence. Below, a single line: according to the nature of the product or service.
ceviri.100: According to the nature of the product or service
ceviri.102: Retargeting: a loop from the site visitor to the custom audience and back to the ad — illustrative graphic
ceviri.103: Three boxes from left to right: site visitor, custom audience and ad. The visitor box carries three neutral dots instead of a person. Above the boxes, a curved arrow returning from the ad to the visitor describes the loop. Above, a pixel and Conversions API label; below, a note reading “a message matched to the level of interest”. In the animation the boxes come in from left to right, then the return arrow is drawn.
ceviri.110: a message matched to the level of interest
ceviri.112: It draws the route the page describes: setting up the ad account and building the audience in three layers, choosing the format according to the nature of the product or service, and then the retargeting loop. The boxes are an example interface drawing, not taken from a real account; no brand or platform mark is used. The four formats are deliberately drawn equal — the page doesn't hold any one above the others. The bands and boxes carry no figures, because they don't show a measurement such as audience size, reach or budget.

ceviri.144: The pixel placed on the website and the server-side Conversions API together let conversion data be measured accurately without being affected by browser blockers; they're the foundation of retargeting and optimization.
ceviri.146: The product catalogue is connected to Commerce Manager to set up dynamic ads that automatically show a user the product they visited or added to their basket; a wide product range is managed without producing each ad by hand.

_kararlar.79/109 'Reklam' iki kez: Kayıt 79 'Reklam hesabı'nın ilk satırı, 109 ise retargeting döngüsündeki kutu. Aynı Türkçe dizge olduğu için tek karşılık zorunlu: ikisi de 'Ad'. 79+80 birlikte 'Ad / account' okunuyor, 109 tek başına 'Ad' — ikisi de doğru.
_kararlar.özel kitle / lookalike kitle: Meta'nın kendi terimleri: 'custom audience' ve 'lookalike audience'. /dijital-pazarlama/ ve /aso/ sayfalarındaki kararla tutarlı.
_kararlar.59 YERLEŞİM → PLACEMENTS: Meta arayüzünde reklamın gösterileceği yer 'placement' olarak geçer; çoğul kullanıldı çünkü sayaç birden çok yerleşimi sayıyor.
_kararlar.31/139 sonuç başına maliyet → cost per r: Meta'nın rapor panelindeki metrik adı. 'cost per acquisition' Google tarafının terimi, burada yanlış olurdu.
_kararlar.112 temsilî görsel notu: İki beyan birebir korundu: dört formatın BİLEREK eşit çizildiği ve 'sayfa hiçbirini diğerine üstün saymıyor'; ve bantların üzerinde rakam olmamasının gerekçesi (kitle büyüklüğü, erişim, bütçe gibi bir ölçü göstermiyorlar).
_kararlar.23/131 itiraz süreci → an appeal is star: Meta'nın hesap kısıtlamalarında kullandığı resmî süreç adı 'appeal'.
